_about: Public-domain Pierre Pourrat (1871-1957, Sulpician) in English for the Word Hoard: Christian Spirituality, vols I-III, tr. W. H. Mitchell and S. P. Jacques (London, 1922-1927), and Theology of the Sacraments (St. Louis: Herder, 1910), from Internet Archive scans. Added 2026-10-18 by lane A, round 32 (my pick); Adam may veto the whole shelf. Every printing dated before 1930, so public domain in the US. No uids minted.

pourrat-christian-spirituality-1: Christian Spirituality, vol. I, tr. W. H. Mitchell and S. P. Jacques (London: Burns Oates and Washbourne, MCMXXII)
pourrat-christian-spirituality-2: Christian Spirituality in the Middle Ages, vol. II, tr. S. P. Jacques (London: Burns Oates and Washbourne, MCMXXIV)
pourrat-christian-spirituality-3: Christian Spirituality: Later Developments, vol. III, tr. W. H. Mitchell (London: Burns Oates and Washbourne, MCMXXVII)
pourrat-theology-sacraments: Theology of the Sacraments, authorized translation from the third French edition (St. Louis: B. Herder, 1910)
